finding: BuildingOperationStep calls SAVE before publishing the operation phase, but BuildingLaneJournal could return the previous SAVE result under its1.5s throttle even after private ENTRY/SWEEP phase changed.
implementation: Throttle SAVE only within the same recorded attempted phase. Record the attempt phase after exact owner/operation admission, alongside the original1.5s sampling bound. Existing lane-roster invalidation and changed-only publication remain.
consumer: Existing BuildingOperationStep callback tail calls producer before operation phase publication; CortexClearBuilding CHECK/ADOPT still consume the existing lane format. No new dormant broker, observer, schema or task owner.
limits: A sampling attempt can still refuse and is not a current-checkpoint acknowledgement.
No producer-owned aggregate snapshot, monotonic revision or authenticated current-owner request/replay is implemented by this fix.
Actor/native/settings/budget continuity and physical ownership handback remain incomplete or unverified.
